debug.description: Enable debug-level logging — very verbose, disable in production

log_dir.description: Directory where CloudKitty writes its log files

api_host.description: IP address the CloudKitty API process binds to; 0.0.0.0 binds to all interfaces

api_port.description: TCP port the CloudKitty API server listens on

api_workers.description: Number of parallel WSGI worker processes; recommended value is 1-2x the vCPU count

db_connection.description: SQLAlchemy connection URL for the main CloudKitty database

keystone_www_authenticate_uri.description: Public Keystone endpoint URI advertised to unauthenticated clients in 401 responses

keystone_auth_url.description: Internal Keystone endpoint this service uses to validate tokens and fetch service catalog

memcached_servers.description: Memcached server(s) for Keystone token cache; reduces repeated Keystone round-trips

host_port.description: Memcached server address in host:port format

keystone_auth_type.description: Keystone authentication plugin for this service account — almost always 'password'

keystone_project_domain_name.description: Keystone domain that owns the service project

keystone_user_domain_name.description: Keystone domain that owns the cloudkitty service user account

keystone_project_name.description: Keystone project the cloudkitty service account is a member of

keystone_username.description: Keystone username of the CloudKitty service account

keystone_password.description: Password for the CloudKitty Keystone service account

keystone_region_name.description: OpenStack region this CloudKitty instance is deployed in

storage_backend.description: Storage driver for rated data frames: 'sqlalchemy' (default) or 'elasticsearch'

storage_version.description: Storage API version — use 2 for CloudKitty >= Stein; use 1 only on Rocky or older

elasticsearch_host.description: Elasticsearch cluster URL — required only when storage_backend is 'elasticsearch'

elasticsearch_index.description: Elasticsearch index name prefix for CloudKitty data — required only when storage_backend is 'elasticsearch'

fetcher_backend.description: Backend that discovers projects/tenants to rate: 'keystone' or 'source'

fetcher_region_name.description: OpenStack region the fetcher targets when listing projects via Keystone

collect_window.description: Width in seconds of each metrics time slice fetched per collection run (must divide evenly into collect_period)

collect_period.description: Length in seconds of each billing/rating period — typically 3600 (hourly) or 86400 (daily)

collect_services.description: CloudKitty service identifiers to collect and rate — must match configured collector metrics

service.description: Service identifier, e.g. compute, volume, image, network.bw.in, network.floating

rating_backend.description: Rating module: 'hashmap' for rule-table pricing, 'pyscripts' for Python scripts, 'noop' to disable rating

hashmap_db_connection.description: SQLAlchemy connection URL for the hashmap module's rule database — usually identical to db_connection

oslo_policy_dirs.description: Directories relative to the config dir that contain additional policy override YAML files
